onboarding.title: {appName} is designed to be controlled by AI
onboarding.intro: You do not draw anything yourself. An AI agent reads your code and delivers flows, documents and reviews, and {appName} checks every file and line they point at and shows the result as animated diagrams.
onboarding.example1: Show what happens when a user places an order.
onboarding.example2: Write an overview of how the backend is organised.
onboarding.example3: Review the branch feature/checkout against main.
onboarding.outro: New analyses appear in the list on the left as soon as the agent saves them. You can change this choice and reopen this guide with Guide in the window bar.
setup.connectText.claude: Run this once in any terminal. Claude Code then has the {appName} tools in every session.
setup.connectText.codex: Run this once in any terminal. Codex then has the {appName} tools in every session.
setup.connectText.manual: Point your agent at {appName}'s MCP server. It speaks streamable HTTP, listens on loopback only and needs no token:
setup.guideTitle.claude: 2. Install the skill for Claude Code
setup.guideText.claude: The skill tells Claude Code when to use {appName} and how to build good flows and reviews. It is installed in your personal skills folder.
setup.guideText.codex: The skill tells Codex when to use {appName} and how to build good flows and reviews. It is installed in your Codex skills folder.
setup.guideText.manual: The guide tells the agent when to use {appName} and how to build good flows and reviews. Copy it into the agent’s instructions, or let the agent read it as the MCP resource below.
